about_the_game:
Further personalize your Nexus: The Zoraidian Oracle game with this expanded customization pack. 

This pack includes:

  • 4 additional deck backs (7 Elements, Balance, Stained Glass Star Wind, and the Weaver badge art)

  • 5 additional play field backgrounds (Castle of Mist, Forest Temple, Mountain Castle, Seven Stars and Red Dragon)

  • 3 additional music tracks (Treasure Hunter, Lord of Souls, and Force of Nature)
